description: Angular component for managing link labels in a rule chain UI, including label selection, creation, filtering, and integration with rule chain service.

classes.name: LinkLabelsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing link labels with features like filtering, custom labels, and integration with rule chain service.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form control.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering a callback when the control is touched.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes filtered labels observable based on form control value changes.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, triggers label list reload if relevant properties change.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value, initializes labels list, and updates form control.

methods.name: prepareLabelsList
methods.description: Fetches labels either from rule chain service or from allowedLabels input.

methods.name: displayLabelFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a label.

methods.name: textIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is non-empty.

methods.name: createLinkLabel
methods.description: Creates a new label from input event.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a label from input event if autocomplete is not open or custom labels are allowed.

methods.name: fetchLabels
methods.description: Filters labels based on search text.

methods.name: transformLinkLabel
methods.description: Transforms input string into a label object, adds it if valid.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a label from the list.

methods.name: addLabel
methods.description: Adds a label to the list if not already present.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Updates form control validity on focus.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Propagates current labels as model value.
